## Description

"A small speaker system made entirely of solid cherry wood.The unit is equipped with a 10cm cone type full range unit CFX1287made by A. M. M Sound Lab.The enclosure is made of Mizume-zakura, which is solid and has a beautiful sound. It is made of solid wood. Mizume-zakura is a domestic broad-leaved tree with a specific gravity of about 0.72, and it is 1.5to 2times stronger than ordinary conifers and broad-leaved trees. The S-004is made of 25mm thick Mizume-zakura, and all parts are firmly assembled by removing hozo and mizo.In addition, the exterior is finished with a clear urethane coating to make the most of the beauty of the fabric of Mizume-zakura.The enclosure has an all-round shape with a large round chamfer to improve sound localization. In addition, the front of the speaker unit is processed into a horn shape to apply a light horn load and improve sound clarity.In addition, the unit is fixed by clamping the magnet part of the speaker unit from the front baffle surface with a brass balk and stainless steel bolt and tightening it, which increases the mounting strength of the unit.Sound absorbing materials are not used inside the enclosure, and good characteristics are obtained by making the inside of the enclosure a shape with a large radius that is less likely to generate standing waves.On the front of the unit, in order to avoid high frequency attenuation by the jersey net and metal noise by the metal net, a punching net made of cherry wood is adopted. This punching net uses the red part of cherry wood which is selected and used, and changes by making use of the color difference of the fabric.The speaker terminal uses a gold-plated terminal ST-30machined from a brass round bar.Embedded nuts are installed in both vertical and horizontal positions for use with various speaker stands.When the S-004is installed on a table or on a speaker, three point support using a setting base such as PB-9or PB-10was recommended.PB-9and PB-10are point-based using African ebony, and sound with good separation can be obtained."

name: Specification
description:
## Description

"A 16cm double cone type full range unit that adopts an edgeless structure.A typical speaker unit consists of a flexible damper and an edge to fix the periphery of the diaphragm and the voice coil. The voice coil drives the diaphragm. This is a contradictory arrangement.The FU-16is designed with the diaphragm as free as possible so that it can move reliably even with a small input without being dumped.In the FU-16, the vibration system of the cone paper and voice coil uses a structure in which two points on the back side of the cone are supported by three points each. Normal dampers and edges are not used. Ultra-thin aramid Bakelite is used for the support after precision processing to achieve a suspension with high sensitivity and elasticity.For the magnetic circuit, Alnico 5magnet is adopted as an external magnetic type.There are two types of magnetic circuits : internal and external. In order to minimize magnetic loss by minimizing the number of components, the external magnetic circuit is adopted. Therefore, the FU-16has an external ring-shaped magnet, and the magnetic circuit consists of only three components, a plate and a pole piece. Compared to the 4-5components used in general internal magnetic circuits, the number of contacts in the magnetic circuit is reduced.In addition, the plate and pole piece are made of pure iron with low magnetic loss and excellent permeability, and it is made into an excellent magnetic circuit by performing the prescribed annealing.The voice coil uses an edgewise wound aluminum ribbon wire as a short voice coil type to keep it lightweight. In the FU-16, the gap length of the magnetic circuit is 12mm, and the voice coil of 8mm length is placed inside the gap. The voice coil does not protrude from the magnetic circuit at all when the amplitude is within ¥2mm, and the driving force does not change at all.We try to keep the magnetic flux density at 10,000gauss and keep the frequency balance of all bands.In general, if the magnetic flux density is set too high, the medium and wide range level will rise and the overall frequency balance will be lost. In the case of the FU-16, we have succeeded in reproducing the 40Hz to 16kHz band with a single unit when it is housed in a BX-60(internal volume 60liters) enclosure.The frame is made of gunmetal.In addition, the magnetic circuit part and suspension fixing part are generally fixed only with adhesive, but in FU-16, it is fixed by screw fastening method, which prevents the adhesive layer from remaining without adhesion of the joint part by fixing only with adhesive.The center cap is not used, but the brass cutting equalizer is adopted, which improves the sensitivity of the vibration system and reduces the disturbance of the frequency characteristics in the middle and high range.The frame and equalizer are plated with pearl-like gold.The diaphragm uses astringent paper cone, which is superior in durability and weather resistance among Japanese paper materials.Astringent paper is a material that has been used as a pattern paper for dyeing. It is made of Japanese paper coated with persimmon tannin to increase its strength. Persimmon tannin is durable, water-resistant, and light-resistant, so it can be used for a long period of time. Persimmon tannin is also insect repellent and has excellent storage stability.In the FU-16, astringent paper is used as a straight cone in a double cone. By reducing the shape and size of the subcone, frequency characteristics with a wide band and little peak-dip are obtained. In addition, by reducing the weight of the vibration system to the limit, the equivalent mass can be reduced to 4.5g.The input terminal uses a brass machined gold-plated speaker terminal ST-12.This terminal can fix cables up to 5mm thick with screws.As an option sold separately, there was a bass reflex enclosure BX-60of Yamamoto Acoustic Kogei.This is a universal type enclosure that can be used for other speaker units. A special baffle was prepared for the FU-16. The special baffle is designed to fix the FU-16from the back side. The front side is a short horn type. In addition, two bolts are used to hold the FU-16from the baffle toward the magnetic circuit of the unit.When FU-16and BX-60were purchased as a set, they were shipped with built-in and adjusted condition."

name: Specification
description:
## Description

"38cm cone shaped woofer with an edgeless structure.In most speaker units, soft materials such as an empire cloth are used as dampers, and urethane foam or cloth edge materials are used. These support systems wrap around the entire diaphragm and thus cause the diaphragm to become excessively damped. As a result, the rise of sound becomes dull and the afterglow becomes unnatural.In order to improve this point, the LU38has a structure in which the vibration system is supported by three points each at two locations, the voice coil bobbin and the diaphragm center, and is supported by a hard material called Bakelite without using conventional edge dampers.The addition, the LU38adopts a new shape of suspension which is an improvement of the conventional butterfly damper to obtain excellent linearity and amplitude resistance characteristics. In the support system which used the conventional edge and damper, the linearity deterioration appears considerably at the amplitude of ¥5mm or more, but in the LU38, sufficient ?????? is maintained up to ¥8mm or more.The magnetic circuit uses an external magnetic ring type of high-quality Alnico 5magnet (3.5kg). The pole and plate are made of high-purity pure iron with excellent permeability through magnetic annealing. The external magnetic circuit has a feature that the magnetic circuit can be made stronger than the general internal magnetic circuit for its volume.The LU38uses only three types of magnetic circuit components : a magnet, a pole, and a plate. Compared to a conventional internal magnetic circuit that requires four to five parts, the LU38has less magnetic loss and less magnetostriction.The magnetic circuit of the conventional speaker was fixed only with adhesive, but in the LU38, it is bonded together with bolt fastening, which improves the strength of the whole unit including the magnetic circuit.The long pole type magnetic circuit is adopted in the magnetic circuit of LU38, and it has succeeded in achieving both large driving force and large amplitude.The long voice coil drive circuit used in general units enables large amplitude and is advantageous for low-frequency playback. However, playback efficiency is reduced and only half to a fraction of the driving force generated by the voice coil can be used, resulting in a lack of information.In the long pole type magnetic circuit adopted in the LU38, a voice coil with a winding width of 9mm is positioned in a pole (magnetic pole) part with an extremely long and wide area of 17mm in length, and it has driving areas of 4mm each in the upper and lower direction, so that it can exert 100% driving force up to ¥4mm amplitude.In addition, in the woofer unit, the high and low magnetic flux density is not an indication of reproducibility in the low frequency range, but is related only to the high and low efficiency in the middle frequency range. Therefore, in spite of the adoption of a magnet with strong magnetic force in the LU38, the magnetic flux density is limited to 10,500gauss, and the magnetic force is used to increase the driving area of the pole part. In addition to the adoption of a 10cm diameter voice coil in the LU38, it realizes a unit with high efficiency of 98dB/W/m and high reproducibility in the low frequency range.The voice coil uses an edge-wise wound voice coil made of flat aluminum wire.The vibration system of LU38has been reduced in weight to the extent that its strength can be maintained. It has achieved a lightweight and highly rigid vibration system with an actual diaphragm volume of 33g and equivalent mass of 48g.In addition, in order to reduce air resistance around the voice coil, the center cap has been eliminated and a wooden equalizer has been adopted to improve the frequency characteristics in the mid-range.Astringent paper is used for the diaphragm.Astringent paper has been used for dyeing patterns in Japan for a long time. It is made of Japanese paper coated with persimmon tannin and laminated on it. It is strong, resistant to water, and highly durable. Moreover, it can be used for a long period of time with peace of mind because it can be stored and protected against insects.Also, the shape of the cone is a simple straight type.The frame is a cast aluminum alloy frame of approximately 3.5kg with high structural strength.In addition, this frame is not painted, but the surface is anodized to harden it and prevent aging.There was a magnet reinforcing ring made of gunmetal as an option sold separately."

name: Specification
description:
## Description

"A large wood horn that can be incorporated into the enclosure.It is designed to be mounted in an enclosure and can also be used in vertical twin systems. The size of the horn is the maximum size for the built-in type, and the directivity is set narrow at 85� horizontal and 40� vertical for the tendency of monitor tone sound.The internal separator fins are designed to be as thin and sharp as possible to ensure smooth frequency and directional characteristics up to the high end by extending the high frequency band.The separator fin is made of ebony, the hardest, heaviest and most tough material of all wood. The top and bottom plates are grooved and the separator fin is inserted and fixed to ensure sufficient strength with a thickness of less than 9mm.The structure is based on the conventional design policy of Yamamoto Acoustic Kogei Co., Ltd., and consists of a beautiful continuous inner surface on both the upper and lower surfaces and the side surfaces of the inner surface of the horn, realizing smooth and honest characteristics.The horn is made of Japanese hophornbeam cherry laminated wood with an opening of 20mm thick.The Japanese hophornbeam cherry trees used in the F300A are made of sufficiently thick materials, with the top and bottom plates being 115mm thick and the side plates being 30mm thick. This reduces the horn squeaking that often occurs with large horns.3-point support system is adopted for installation.In the F300A, the throat part is made of gunmetal, a large screw is cut in that part, a support is built there, and it is supported only by gunmetal at 3points including the lower part of both sides of the horn.A 7mm high point-supported spacer is made on both sides of the horn, and along with the throat, the tip is rounded into a hemispherical shape to prevent damage to the enclosure."

name: Specification
description:
## Description

"Single stereo type power amplifier using European direct heating 5-pole output tube PT-15.The PT-15is a vacuum tube classified as a transmission tube, but it also has excellent audio performance and sound quality. Since the plate capacity is 30W and the screen grid loss is 15W, the total power capacity has an allowable loss equal to that of Western Electric'Ωs 300B.In the A-04, the PT-15is driven by a direct connection system, and an output of about 10W is obtained by connecting a 5-pole tube.A circuit configuration called the ???????? system is adopted for the direct connection system.This method has a simple structure in which the current flowing through the first stage amplifier tube is directly used as a bias for the drive of the output tube. The amplifier circuit can be composed of only two vacuum tubes without using any coupling capacitor or transformer between them, thus realizing a pure and straight circuit.In the first stage of the A-04, Western Electric'Ωs WE373A direct-heated 5-pole tube for small signal is adopted, and the amplifier circuit is composed only of direct-heated tubes to pursue clearer sound.Two highly regulated mercury-arc rectifier tubes RC¥3are used for the power supply circuit. The plate circuit and the screen grid circuit are separated to supply energy as an independent power supply circuit, which brings out the performance of the 5-pole tube.A low-distortion polypropylene film condenser with excellent response speed is used for the filter condenser.Using the original non-resonant tube socket of Teflon insulation used in A-03and Y-300SS, the super large cut core output transformer wound with Teflon insulation, and the wiring of 1.6mm diameter 6N copper wire used all over the surface through the Teflon tube, the know-how of Yamamoto Sound Craft is applied.The PT-15is equipped with a protective cover for safety as it is a top plate vacuum tube with a high voltage terminal exposed to the outside.This cover has a large round and is plated with champagne gold."
